# Hugo Narrow 2.0.0

Hugo Narrow 2.0 is a structural redesign of the theme. It replaces the top navbar with an adaptive dock and a context bar, consolidates appearance controls, and reduces the configuration surface. It requires Hugo Extended 0.165.0 or newer.

The final v1 release is v1.4.1, preserved on the `v1` branch.

## Highlights

- Adaptive dock: a vertical capsule on wide landscape viewports, a bottom capsule everywhere else. It collapses on scroll and includes home, menu, search, TOC, comments, appearance, and back-to-top actions.
- Context bar: breadcrumbs for all non-home pages, plus series progress, previous/next controls, and a series popover for series posts.
- Unified bordered cards for posts, projects, and series. Cards no longer use cover images or status colors.
- Runtime appearance panel: color scheme, light/dark/system mode, content width, backdrop blur, grain size, and language selection.
- Localized date formatting with per-language month headings for CJK, Vietnamese, Spanish, and Portuguese.
- Native dual-mode Chroma styles via `markup.highlight.style` and `css.ChromaStyles`.
- RTL baseline: language direction, logical CSS properties, mirrored directional icons, and manifest direction.
- Improved accessibility and output: reduced-transparency/contrast handling, forced-colors fallbacks, print styles, PWA metadata, hreflang alternates, and configurable search index size.

## Breaking changes

### Navigation and appearance

- The top navbar and `layouts/_partials/navigation/header.html` were removed. Navigation is provided by the dock and the context bar.
- Removed `header.*` parameters, including `sticky`, `logo`, `showThemeSwitch`, `showDarkModeSwitch`, `showContentWidthSwitch`, `showLanguageSwitch`, and `languageSwitchMode`.
- Removed the `dock` mode parameter. Dock placement is determined by viewport geometry.
- Removed `toc.position` and `toc.pinned`. TOC pinning is a runtime state stored in `localStorage`.
- The language switcher is no longer configurable as a cycle button. It is a secondary popover in the appearance panel.

### Configuration

- Color schemes moved from `params.themes` to `data/themes.yaml`. A new scheme now requires both a `[data-theme="..."]` block in `assets/css/themes.css` and an entry in `data/themes.yaml`.
- `post.license` is now a single string. The v1 map form (`show`, `author`, `name`, `description`, `url`, `displayName`) was removed. The value is displayed in the post meta line; set it to `false` per page to hide it.
- `params.codeblock.style` and `params.codeblock.darkStyle` were removed. Code block colors now come from `markup.highlight.style`; Hugo generates the dark stylesheet from that style's dark counterpart. Use a style that has a dark counterpart, such as `catppuccin-latte`, `github`, or `monokai`.
- Code block collapse options were renamed: `autoCollapseLines` became `maxLines`; `autoCollapseHeight` was removed; `collapsedHeight` is unchanged.
- Date formatting was reduced to `long`, `short`, and `month`. Removed `full`, `medium`, `timeFormat`, and the `kind` argument of the date helper. Month headings are localized automatically by `data/dateFormats.yaml`.
- Site-level gallery configuration is limited to `gallery.enabled`, `gallery.defaultLayout`, and `lightbox.enabled`. Advanced gallery options are configured in page front matter.
- Project front matter no longer supports `status`; project cards no longer render status colors.
- `home.contentOrder` entries are partial names without the `.html` suffix. The v1 form with `.html` is normalized by the theme, but new configurations should omit it.
- Removed the `ui.appearance.*` and `ui.language.*` feature flags; the appearance panel is always fully available.

### Templates and CSS

- Markup and styling moved to shadcn semantic tokens. Custom CSS that referenced v1 `--color-*` variables must use the raw tokens (`--primary`, `--background`, `--foreground`, `--card`, `--popover`, `--border`, `--muted`, `--accent`, and their `*-foreground` variants).
- Removed `layouts/_partials/content/card-base.html` and `layouts/_partials/content/post-license.html`. Use `content/card.html` and the post meta partial instead.
- Removed `assets/css/prose.lists.css` and `assets/css/prose.table.css`; their rules were merged into the remaining prose files.
- Removed `assets/js/ui.js`; client behavior is split across the modules in `assets/js/`.
- Removed the v1 header, mobile navigation, breadcrumb, and menu partials.
- The icon sprite is generated as a single external resource. Custom templates that inline icon paths should use `features/icon.html`.

### Requirements

- Hugo Extended 0.165.0 or newer.
- Tailwind CSS 4 for theme development. The compiled stylesheet remains committed; consumers do not need Node.js unless they change theme templates or utility classes.

## Migration checklist

1. Remove `header.*`, `dock`, `toc.position`, `toc.pinned`, and `timeFormat` from `params.yaml`.
2. Move color scheme definitions to `data/themes.yaml` and keep the matching `[data-theme]` blocks in the site's custom CSS.
3. Replace the v1 `post.license` map with a single string.
4. Set `markup.highlight.style` to a dual-mode style and remove `codeblock.style` / `codeblock.darkStyle`.
5. Update code block collapse settings to `maxLines` and `collapsedHeight`.
6. Move gallery tuning options to page front matter.
7. Update custom CSS variables to the shadcn raw token names.
8. Review custom templates that override the removed header, card, license, or navigation partials.

## Legacy v1 configuration

The v1 parameter reference and migration details are documented in the docs site under "v1 Configuration". The v1 line is maintained on the `v1` branch; v1.4.1 is its final release.
